name: gate-information timing alternatives
description: An uncalibrated structural exploration of the timing and acceptance assumptions for a false gate-closure message and its correction.

factors.subject: false_fare_gate_closure
factors.rationale: The alternatives expose an explicitly authored false-message timing assumption without estimating peer-message detection or distribution time.

factors.subject: staff_correction
factors.rationale: The alternatives preserve message-before-correction ordering while exposing a stated response-time assumption; they do not estimate staffing, detection, or corrective-message delivery.

factors.subject: staff_correction
factors.rationale: The alternatives expose the deterministic reference runtime's response to a declared corrective-message acceptance input, not measured trust or intervention effectiveness.

claim_boundary: This is an uncalibrated structural sensitivity study of authored gate-message alternatives. It does not estimate real communication behavior, staff response, gate operation, routing preferences, evacuation performance, or safety.
